description:
Tae-Wan, a blunt, single, and popular dessert YouTuber. One early morning, he takes Ji-An into his house, who is worried about a kitten in the yard while soaking wet from the rain. Tae-Wan, who secretly has feelings for Ji-An, who usually takes care of the cat from beyond the fence, becomes very nervous, and Ji-An begins to lightly seduce Tae-Wan while teasing him... After a hot night, Ji-An runs away without contacting him or making another appointment?! 

The erotic romance between Ji-An, who is rich but naive and light-hearted, and Tae-Wan, who is serious but sincere about everything!

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)
